status: All trials withheld; none passes the unchanged full surface coverage criteria.
selection: Lowest nominal uncovered ink area among these trials. Still fails release criteria.
historical_geometry_note: rounded048 used 0.48 pitch, 0.4 guard, no 0.5 mm2 fragment filter, and 0.001 mm solid simplification. The six 0.44 mm trials use the same selected geometry. Trial data are historical measurements, not additional released print files.

geometry.method: Original SVG palette weights; minority bands inset and rounded; remainder assigned to local dominant ink.

process.name: myAI Farbbahnen 0.48mm P1S
process.description: It has a general layer height, and results in general layer lines and printing quality. It is suitable for most general printing cases.

coverage.method: CAD layer cross-sections minus union of nominal G-code width capsules with round end caps; arcs flattened to <=0.001 mm chord error
coverage.limitations: Nominal planar footprint, not measured filament flow, surface sheen, bonding or optical opacity. Does not model the order/overlap of neighboring colors. Tiny CAD corner differences and molten material behavior remain uncertain.
